<function name="GetSequenceList" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns a list of all sequences ( animations ) the model has.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table">The list of all sequences ( animations ) the model has. The indices start with 0!</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Example showing table structure. Prints a list of player model sequences.</description>
	<code>PrintTable( Entity(1):GetSequenceList() )</code>
	<output>

```
0	=	ragdoll
1	=	reference
2	=	idle_all_01
3	=	idle_all_02
4	=	idle_all_angry
5	=	idle_all_scared
6	=	idle_all_cower
7	=	cidle_all
8	=	swim_idle_all
9	=	sit
10	=	menu_walk
11	=	menu_combine
12	=	menu_gman
13	=	walk_all
-- The rest of the sequences
```

	</output>

</example>
